statement: I build markets, scale businesses and turn partnerships into
paragraphs: With 20+ years of experience in commercial leadership, I have worked for start-ups, market leaders and market challengers in Africa, selling to businesses, consumers and government. Today I lead regional sales and operations for energy and charging at Roam Electric in Nairobi.

My career runs from healthcare through telecommunications and IoT to renewable energy and electric mobility. In each, the work has been to set the commercial direction, open the market, build the team and partner channels, and keep a firm hand on margin, working capital and cost.

pillars.p: Set the East Africa sales and business development strategy at Sagemcom and delivered US$10M+ in annual contract value.
Subsidiaries and offices in Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi and Mozambique, and a branch in Mombasa.
Solar leasing and PPAs at ecoligo. EV charging, solar PV and battery storage at Roam Electric.
M2M and IoT channels at Vodafone/Vodacom, operator and vendor accounts across the region, and cybersecurity and IT services.
Turnaround consultancy that lifted sales revenue by at least 30%, and end-to-end regional operations at Roam Electric.
EPC and developer partners, channel partner networks, and teams of 5 to 40 people.

career.title: Country Manager
career.summary: Ran ecoligo's East African business, taking solar leasing and PPA projects with commercial and industrial clients to signature.

career.title: Head of Sales / Deputy Managing Director
career.summary: Set the business development and sales strategy for East Africa and led transformation in Grid Infrastructure Services.
points: Delivered targets for sales, operations, margin, working capital, turnover, receivables and expense control.
Led bids, tenders and project management with telecom and energy vendors and operators in Sub-Saharan Africa.
wins: Grew market share from 10% to 22% through a new subsidiary in Uganda and projects in Tanzania and Zambia.
Delivered US$10M+ in annual total contract value in the region.
Structured and negotiated project financing for renewable energy projects.

career.title: Principal Sales Specialist
career.summary: Built the M2M and IoT sales business across East Africa through direct and partner channels.
points: Designed and ran direct and indirect M2M/IoT sales channels.
Recruited channel partners and built a local IoT ecosystem in vertical industries.
wins: M2M revenues up 80% in East Africa.
Award of Excellence: Best IoT/M2M Sales Person of the Year 2015–2016.
Total sales revenue up 73.1%; distribution turnover up 51.1%; retail account base up 115%.

career.title: Account Manager
career.summary: Account management, bids and business development with telecom operators and vendors across Sub-Saharan Africa.
points: Worked with operators and vendors including Huawei, Ericsson, Safaricom, Airtel and MTN.
Handled RFIs, RFPs, proposals, negotiation and contract execution.
wins: Formulated a go-to-market strategy that delivered consistent sales objectives.
Grew sales 22% in Kenya and 38% in East Africa over two years.
Set up subsidiaries in Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi and Mozambique.

career.title: Commercial Manager
career.summary: Commercial, business development and project management for telecom deployment work.
points: Recruited and hired 40 employees; led the regional commercial team.
Managed subcontractors, cost control, working capital and cash-flow forecasting.
wins: Grew billed revenue 50% in the first year (34% in Kenya, 18% in Uganda and Tanzania).

career.title: Sales Manager
career.summary: Led sales of internet services, modems and SIM cards at the company formerly known as Net@home Wireless Networks.
points: Coached the sales team and led account planning for retention and acquisition.
wins: Acquired a portfolio of 500 accounts: corporates, SMEs, SoHos and residential.
Built distribution and enterprise channels that grew revenues 60%.
Set up the Mombasa branch, lifting revenues 26%.

career.title: Partner Sales Representative
career.summary: Full-cycle sales of OTC and healthcare products.
points: Trained new employees and contributed to event marketing and brand promotion.
wins: Grew the customer base 64% by opening new accounts across Kenya.
Sustained monthly sales of KES 5M for the OTC and healthcare range.

items.p: Coached and mentored sales staff at Mobiserve and Zote Telkom. At ecoligo, cut process bottlenecks by training the team on practices, procedures and performance.
Raised her ecoligo team's Work Health Index by 10 points over two years. Worked with HR to streamline hiring and onboarding and to improve welfare through allowances and rewards.
Restructured commercial teams in her consultancy roles to bring in new talent, reach new markets and build capabilities.
Put people and offices in place for new subsidiaries and branches in Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi, Mozambique and Mombasa.
Managed customer, vendor and partner relationships daily, from EPC partners at ecoligo to channel partners at Vodacom, and negotiated acquisitions of competitor companies.
Set budgets with controls, managed working capital and receivables at Sagemcom, and improved cash positions through better margins and credit terms.
